name: updateStatusSummary
description: Device and user counts by Windows update status across the tenant (beta API)

metadata.name: updateState
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const n = (v) => { const x = typeof v === 'number' ? v : Number(v); return isNaN(x) ? 0 : x; }; const err = n($['errorDeviceCount']) + n($['conflictDeviceCount']); const nonCompliant = n($['nonCompliantDeviceCount']); const total = err + nonCompliant + n($['compliantDeviceCount']) + n($['remediatedDeviceCount']) + n($['unknownDeviceCount']) + n($['notApplicableDeviceCount']); return err > 0 ? 'error' : nonCompliant > 0 ? 'warning' : total === 0 ? 'unknown' : 'success'; })() }}
